potential_name: Mishin, Mehl, and Papaconstantopoulos (2002) B2-NiAl EAM
authors: Y. Mishin, M. J. Mehl, and D. A. Papaconstantopoulos
citation: Y. Mishin, M. J. Mehl, and D. A. Papaconstantopoulos (2002), 'Embedded-atom potential for B2-NiAl', Physical Review B 65(22), 224114.
fitting_scope: Historical EAM optimized for the B2 phase of NiAl, fitted to experimental properties and ab initio data for multiple crystal structures; accurately reproduces basic B2-NiAl lattice properties, planar faults, and point-defect characteristics.
implementation_notes: LAMMPS eam/alloy conversion produced by Chandler Becker (14 Feb 2009) from the authors' plt tabulated functions; historical model-generation comparison role, not the primary production recommendation. Age alone is not treated as proof of lower accuracy.
known_warnings: NIST documentation cautions that the elemental descriptions taken from this B2-optimized alloy fit may perform poorly for pure Ni, pure Al, and non-B2 Ni-Al phases; this directly affects formation-energy transferability across the five selected compositions.

comment_lines: Ni-Al EAM from Y. Mishin, et al., PRB 65, 224114 (2002).
LAMMPS setfl format.  Conversion by C. A. Becker from Y. Mishin files.
